name: Frigidaire® 28" 13 Cu. Ft. White Garage Ready Upright Freezer
shortDescription: The 13 Cu. Ft. upright freezer offers ultimate flexibility with its convertible freezer-to-refrigerator feature and garage-ready design. It ensures consistent freezing with the EvenTemp™ cooling system and provides flexible organization.

features.text: Effortlessly convert your freezer to a refrigerator with the touch of a button, for ultimate flexibility whether you're hosting a gathering or just need extra space.

Place this unit in your garage without worry. As a freezer, this unit is designed to perform in temperatures ranging from 0°F to 110°F. As a refrigerator, it performs in temperatures ranging from 38°F to 110°F.
Keep food frozen for two days if there is a power outage with our superior tight seal that locks in cold air.
Easily organize your family's frozen favorites with our organization system that allows you to make the most of every available square inch of your freezer.
Door Ajar and High Temp Alarm
Monitor the ideal environment for your frozen foods with our audible temperature alarm that alerts you if the door is left open or the temperature rises.
Our cooling system optimizes airflow to ensure a consistent temperature throughout the freezer, helping preserve food quality.
Know at a glance that your freezer is keeping your favorites safely frozen and fresh with our power-on indicator light.
Never waste time chipping away ice in your freezer again with our frost-free design that does the work for you.
Door can be installed to open left or right based on your needs.
